protocol.actual_target: 13 measured original source channels at actual origin+6; missing observations excluded by boolean mask. No fabricated labels, no fabricated actions or counterfactual reward.
protocol.anti_cheat: Prediction reads only original past source inputs, missingness masks, chronological last observed values, station ID, future-known calendar. Future observed numeric targets are read inside loss only after model forecast, never in candidate input. Automated source boundary checks are scoped; full independent access/reward/outcome attestation remains INCONCLUSIVE and blocks scientific promotion.
protocol.calendar: six deterministic future-known sine/cosine features hour/day-of-week/day-of-year at origin+6; exogenous time context, NOT a physical candidate intervention or source measurement.
protocol.checkpoint: Commit original trained final.pt, optimizer, torch RNG, normalizer, original source/version and train-order hashes, FIT_RECEIPT and DEV_PREDICTIONS to Git-owned research/replay-bundles/LATFUSE002/ on isolated branch. Re-evaluate from immutable model bytes in clean checkout without refit. If self-push denied, STOP and report unqualified artifact.
protocol.claim_rules: No matched trained comparator here. Never claim architectural superiority, commercially meaningful risk or action ability, independent heldout generalization, or full calibration/probability correctness. No automated TEST access.
protocol.development: Fixed same station-hour rule every 336 hours throughout previously exposed 2015 DEV, scored once after original checkpoint bytes are written. Report all two seeds, no picking a winner.
protocol.input_source: 12 original Beijing air monitoring stations, 13 real channels; input mask, preceding last observed value and exact elapsed-age computed chronologically without future lookahead; time-typed station owner.
protocol.limitations: Single model training is not matched neural architecture comparison or real-world qualification. Both 2014 validation and 2015 DEV remain research evidence only; no protected 2016-17 access or counterfactual action claim.
protocol.normalization: Per-channel FIT-train-only mean/standard deviation on original observed 13D source (log1p of first six measured nonnegative pollutants). No validation/development stats used in preprocessing. Missing original sensor values never invented as true targets.
protocol.question: Can a 96-99k FP32 fixed-state fusion with high-retention gated delta, multirate slow channels and belief-conditioned associative retrieval learn authentic future pollutant/sensor observations after 6 hours?
protocol.recurrent_state: H80 fast80 +slow80 +key/value matrix16x16 +16 slots x80=1,696 FP32 scalars plus16 bool flags; exactly 6,800 nominal FP32 bytes per independent stream. No extra recurrent state allocations.
protocol.retention_fix: Retention and write maps fully trainable; retention bias initializes sigmoid to 0.995, write to 0.1. Multi-rate slow channels 0.90..0.99999 and belief-informed content query reuse original state bytes.

source_cutoffs.protected: 2016-01-01 onward: numeric lines not parsed; sealed

protocol.stop: Exactly two predeclared seeds x128 actual original-data optimizer steps; no retrospective repetitions or hyperparameter tuning on 2015 DEV. Stop on count/input/gradient/nonfinite/SourceSHA or runtime integrity failure. No protected years.
protocol.train_selection: Two original real station-hour IDs independently sampled with fixed Python random.Random seeds 202601 and 202602, 8 source-authorized cases/update, sampled uniformly independent of target availability; every origin has preceding 24 chronological physical hours and +6 real target within FIT-train cutoff.
protocol.training: Fresh FP32 98,775 active and deployed parameters per seed; original source observational windows; AdamW lr 0.0005, wd0.001, forward 0.8 Gaussian NLL +0.2 normalized absolute error; clip global norm1. No pretrained encoder or zero dummy parameters.
protocol.validation: Fixed chronological stations and every 336 hours starting at 2014-09-01+history, excluding any FIT training targets, standard Gaussian normalized NLL, MAE, 90% nominal coverage, raw PM2.5 MAE; compare unmatched practical persistence reference only.

real_world_source.name: UCI501 Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality original archive (12 physically recorded stations)
